verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an open file format plus open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON), and self-hosting means users control where their data lives, so leaving with open-format design data is plausible. However, no evidence documents a bulk 'export all my data' workflow, and one hands-on user reported being able to export only a single layer rather than a whole file as PDF/JPG. missing for 10: documented bulk/account-wide export of all files and assets, explicit export procedure for the open file format, independent corroboration of complete data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Enjoy open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON as well as Penpot's open file format.
